inputs.description: Password of the administrator gitea_admin, created at the first start. Change it in Gitea after you sign in; the Secret is not applied again.
inputs.name: adminPassword

inputs.description: Encrypts stored credentials such as two-factor secrets. Keep it for the life of the database.
inputs.name: secretKey

inputs.description: Authenticates Git hooks to the Gitea web process.
inputs.name: internalToken

inputs.description: Signs OAuth2 tokens. Rotating it signs out OAuth2 clients.
inputs.name: jwtSecret

zh-CN.summary: Git 托管服务，仓库放在卷上，搭配 PostgreSQL。

zh-TW.summary: Git 代管服務，儲存庫放在磁碟區，搭配 PostgreSQL。

metadata.name: Gitea
metadata.summary: Git hosting, with repositories on a volume and PostgreSQL.

zh-CN.summary: 免 root 的镜像以 UID 1000 运行，根文件系统只读，没有服务账号令牌，所有额外权限都去掉了。对外连接没有限制。注册已关闭，安装页面也锁住了。

zh-TW.summary: 免 root 的映像檔以 UID 1000 執行，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有服務帳號權杖，所有額外權限都拿掉了。對外連線沒有限制。註冊已關閉，安裝頁面也鎖住了。

zh-CN.mitigation: INSTALL_LOCK 设为 true，配置都来自环境变量。Gitea 启动前，初始化容器会用生成好的密码创建 gitea_admin 账号。
zh-CN.risk: 安装页面如果没锁，第一个来的访客就能配置这台服务器。

zh-TW.mitigation: INSTALL_LOCK 設為 true，設定都來自環境變數。Gitea 啟動前，初始化容器會用產生好的密碼建立 gitea_admin 帳號。
zh-TW.risk: 安裝頁面如果沒鎖，第一個來的訪客就能設定這台伺服器。

risks.mitigation: INSTALL_LOCK is true and the settings come from environment variables. Before Gitea starts, an init container creates the gitea_admin account with the generated password.
risks.risk: If the install page is not locked, the first visitor can configure the server.

zh-CN.mitigation: DISABLE_REGISTRATION 设为 true。用户由管理员在站点管理里创建。
zh-CN.risk: 任何人都可以自己注册账号。

zh-TW.mitigation: DISABLE_REGISTRATION 設為 true。使用者由管理員在網站管理裡建立。
zh-TW.risk: 任何人都可以自己註冊帳號。

risks.mitigation: DISABLE_REGISTRATION is true. The administrator creates users in Site Administration.

zh-CN.mitigation: Ingress 只转发 HTTP，所以 SSH 服务器是关闭的。用 HTTPS 搭配密码或访问令牌来 clone 和 push。
zh-CN.risk: 无法使用 SSH 访问 Git。

zh-TW.mitigation: Ingress 只轉送 HTTP，所以 SSH 伺服器是關閉的。用 HTTPS 搭配密碼或存取權杖來 clone 和 push。
zh-TW.risk: 無法使用 SSH 存取 Git。

risks.mitigation: The Ingress carries HTTP only, so the SSH server is off. Clone and push over HTTPS with a password or an access token.
risks.risk: Git over SSH does not work.

zh-CN.mitigation: Gitea 默认会拦截指向私有地址的 webhook。模板没有限制对外连接，需要限制时，请添加 egress NetworkPolicy。模板没有配置 SMTP 服务器，所以 Gitea 不会发邮件。
zh-CN.risk: Webhook、镜像和仓库迁移，都会让服务器去访问用户指定的地址。

zh-TW.mitigation: Gitea 預設會擋掉指向私有位址的 webhook。範本沒有限制對外連線，需要限制時，請加上 egress NetworkPolicy。範本沒有設定 SMTP 伺服器，所以 Gitea 不會寄信。
zh-TW.risk: Webhook、鏡像和儲存庫遷移，都會讓伺服器去連使用者指定的位址。

risks.mitigation: Gitea blocks private webhook targets by default. The template does not limit outbound traffic. To limit it, add an egress NetworkPolicy. No SMTP server is set up, so Gitea sends no email.
risks.risk: Webhooks, mirrors and repository migrations make the server send requests to addresses that users choose.

zh-CN.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 组件会为每个集群创建对应的 RBAC 权限。Gitea 的 Pod 没有令牌。
zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的数据库实例会用 operator 创建的身份调用 Kubernetes API。

zh-TW.mitigation: cloudnative-pg 元件會為每個叢集建立對應的 RBAC 權限。Gitea 的 Pod 沒有權杖。
zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的資料庫實例會用 operator 建立的身分呼叫 Kubernetes API。

risks.mitigation: The cloudnative-pg component creates the RBAC permissions for each cluster. The Gitea Pod has no token.
risks.risk: The CloudNativePG database instances call the Kubernetes API with an identity that the operator creates.

zh-CN.mitigation: 另外备份 gitea-data 卷，例如用 gitea dump。正式上线前，先演练一次恢复。
zh-CN.risk: 仓库和 LFS 对象放在卷上，数据库备份不会包含它们。

zh-TW.mitigation: 另外備份 gitea-data 磁碟區，例如用 gitea dump。正式上線前，先演練一次還原。
zh-TW.risk: 儲存庫和 LFS 物件放在磁碟區上，資料庫備份不會包含它們。

risks.mitigation: Back up the gitea-data volume separately, for example with gitea dump. Try a restore before you go to production.
risks.risk: Repositories and LFS objects live on the volume, so the database backup does not include them.

security.summary: The rootless image runs as UID 1000 with a read-only root filesystem, no service-account token and all capabilities dropped. Outbound traffic is not limited. Sign-up is closed and the install page is locked.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: gitea-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gitea
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: gitea
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: gitea
        app.kubernetes.io/name: gitea
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      initContainers:
      # Applies database migrations, then creates the administrator if no
      # account with that name exists.
      - name: setup
        image: docker.gitea.com/gitea:28.2.0-rootless@sha256:94807314454f6525994a3b76286ba12bc7e7f8cd14f61d9e67431767f8103306
        command:
        - /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh
        - /bin/sh
        - -ec
        - |
          gitea migrate
          if ! gitea admin user list --admin | awk '{print $2}' | grep -qx gitea_admin; then
            gitea admin user create --admin --username gitea_admin \
              --email "gitea_admin@{{ .Domain }}" --password "$ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
              --must-change-password=false
          fi
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 512Mi
        env: &env
        - name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: gitea-secrets
              key: admin-password
        - name: GITEA__server__DOMAIN
          value: '{{ .Domain }}'
        - name: GITEA__server__ROOT_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}/
        - name: GITEA__server__DISABLE_SSH
          value: 'true'
        - name: GITEA__server__START_SSH_SERVER
          value: 'false'
        - name: GITEA__server__LFS_START_SERVER
          value: 'true'
        - name: GITEA__server__LFS_JWT_SECRET__FILE
          value: /secrets/lfs-jwt-secret
        - name: GITEA__security__INSTALL_LOCK
          value: 'true'
        - name: GITEA__security__SECRET_KEY__FILE
          value: /secrets/secret-key
        - name: GITEA__security__INTERNAL_TOKEN__FILE
          value: /secrets/internal-token
        - name: GITEA__oauth2__JWT_SECRET__FILE
          value: /secrets/jwt-secret
        - name: GITEA__service__DISABLE_REGISTRATION
          value: 'true'
        - name: GITEA__database__DB_TYPE
          value: postgres
        - name: GITEA__database__HOST
          value: gitea-db-rw:5432
        - name: GITEA__database__NAME
          value: gitea
        - name: GITEA__database__USER
          value: gitea
        - name: GITEA__database__PASSWD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: gitea-db-app
              key: password
        - name: GITEA__database__SSL_MODE
          value: verify-full
        - name: PGSSLROOTCERT
          value: /db-ca/ca.crt
        - name: GITEA__log__MODE
          value: console
        volumeMounts: &mounts
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/gitea
        - name: config
          mountPath: /etc/gitea
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: secrets
          mountPath: /secrets
          readOnly: true
        - name: db-ca
          mountPath: /db-ca
          readOnly: true
      containers:
      - name: gitea
        image: docker.gitea.com/gitea:28.2.0-rootless@sha256:94807314454f6525994a3b76286ba12bc7e7f8cd14f61d9e67431767f8103306
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 3000
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 1Gi
        env: *env
        volumeMounts: *mounts
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/healthz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /api/healthz
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: gitea-data
      - name: config
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 16Mi
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 2Gi
      - name: secrets
        secret:
          secretName: gitea-secrets
          items:
          - {key: secret-key, path: secret-key}
          - {key: internal-token, path: internal-token}
          - {key: jwt-secret, path: jwt-secret}
          - {key: lfs-jwt-secret, path: lfs-jwt-secret}
      - name: db-ca
        secret:
          secretName: gitea-db-ca
          items:
          - {key: ca.crt, path: ca.crt}
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gitea
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: gitea
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 3000
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: gitea
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: gitea-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: gitea
            port:
              number: 3000
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: gitea-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: gitea
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:18-minimal-trixie@sha256:0675340b02be838319b9b6f323c206693e519dcd62ec729d539be9f46bb7a2f9
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: gitea
      owner: gitea
      encoding: UTF8
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: '1'
      memory: 1Gi
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: 128MB
      max_connections: '100'
